text:
anya: quick spike idea: treat batcher as 3 stages (ingest/hold/exec) with explicit lease tokens so we can reason about eviction without leaking kv ownership.
bryan: sounds good. how does lease look? TTL + weight + preemptible bit?
anya: yeah. minimal: id, weight, expires_at, preemptible, fastpath_hint. Enqueue returns lease, holding can Revoke(lease,reason).
mika: need commit semantics: holding -> exec commit marks handoff of kv pointers. before commit, only weak refs.
bryan: telemetry: map old metric names to new ones, add holding_wait_p95 and exec_latency_p99. add evict_reason label.
sre-bot: deploy-canary started by @anya - batcher-refactor-canary-2026-03-22
anya: ordering risk if evicted+retried. exec should dedupe by seq_id for short window (~1s).
mika: also surface length_histogram from holding so exec can pick kernel paths early.
bryan: operator knobs: headroom_pct=20, eviction_hysteresis_ms=50, fastpath_threshold=8 tokens.
anya: migration: adapter exposes old API but implements holding when flag enabled. rollout per shard. I'll open a tiny PoC PR and a harness to replay traces.
